messages.subject: Quartz — negotiation strategy ahead of v3
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

For our counter-draft (v3): land the cap at £10.625m (25% EV), basket at £510,000, claims period at 21 months, and keep Geoffrey's covenant at 30 months (concede Patricia at 24). On the Wexbourne change-of-control point I'll insist on a specific indemnity pending consent rather than a price chip. Marlow's FDD supports the £4.1m target working capital. Comments before I send tomorrow?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
